question: Which insurance policy documents are available in the knowledge base?
ground_truth: The knowledge base contains two policy documents: the Star Health Assure Insurance Policy brochure and the Group Health Insurance policy document by Max Bupa Health Insurance Company.

question: Which policy covers Assisted Reproduction Treatment?
ground_truth: The Star Health Assure Insurance Policy covers Assisted Reproduction Treatment, subject to a waiting period of 24 months from the date of first inception of the policy. The company pays for one Assisted Reproduction Treatment cycle in a policy year.

question: Which policy offers automatic restoration of the sum insured?
ground_truth: The Star Health Assure Insurance Policy provides automatic restoration of the sum insured, unlimited number of times and up to 100% each time, triggered immediately upon partial or full utilisation of the sum insured.

question: Compare the waiting period for pre-existing diseases between Star Health Assure and Group Health Insurance.
ground_truth: Star Health Assure: 36 months for 1-year and 2-year policies, 30 months for 3-year policies. Group Health Insurance specifies waiting periods for specific conditions (e.g. 24 months for kidney stones, tonsils) but does not state a blanket PED waiting period in the same way.

question: Which policy would be better for a family wanting to cover up to 9 members under one plan?
ground_truth: Star Health Assure is the better choice as it explicitly allows up to 9 members of a family under a single family floater policy, covering adults from 18 to 75 years and dependent children from 16 days to 25 years.

question: How many days notice must a policyholder give to cancel a Star Health Assure policy?
ground_truth: The policyholder may cancel the Star Health Assure policy any time during the term by giving 7 days written notice.

question: Are day care treatments covered under Star Health Assure?
ground_truth: Yes, all day care treatments are covered under Star Health Assure Insurance Policy.

question: What is the waiting period for pre-existing diseases under a 1-year Star Health Assure policy?
ground_truth: Under a 1-year or 2-year Star Health Assure policy, pre-existing diseases are excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy.

question: What is the waiting period for pre-existing diseases under a 3-year Star Health Assure policy?
ground_truth: Under a 3-year Star Health Assure policy, pre-existing diseases are excluded until the expiry of 30 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy.

question: What is the maximum sum insured available under Star Health Assure?
ground_truth: The maximum sum insured available under Star Health Assure is Rs. 2 Crore.

question: What is the minimum hospitalisation period required to claim Group Hospital Cash Benefit?
ground_truth: The insured person must be hospitalised for a minimum of 2 days with a continuous and completed period of at least 24 hours to claim the Group Hospital Cash Benefit.

question: What is the waiting period for treatment of kidney stones under Group Health Insurance?
ground_truth: Treatment for stones in the urinary system (kidney stones) is subject to a specific waiting period of 24 months from the date of commencement of coverage under Group Health Insurance.

question: What refund does a policyholder get if they cancel Group Health Insurance before a quarter of the policy period has elapsed?
ground_truth: If the policyholder cancels Group Health Insurance within the first quarter (up to 1/4 of the policy period), a 50% refund of the premium is provided.

question: Are sexually transmitted diseases covered under Group Health Insurance?
ground_truth: No, treatment for sexually transmitted diseases including Genital Warts, Syphilis, Gonorrhoea, Genital Herpes, Chlamydia, Pubic Lice and Trichomoniasis is excluded under Group Health Insurance.

question: Which policy is better for a young couple wanting maternity or fertility treatment coverage?
ground_truth: Star Health Assure is the better option as it explicitly covers Assisted Reproduction Treatment after a 24-month waiting period and covers In Utero Fetal Surgery after 24 months. The Group Health Insurance policy document does not mention such benefits.

question: What specific conditions have a 24-month waiting period under Group Health Insurance?
ground_truth: The following conditions have a 24-month specific waiting period under Group Health Insurance: stones in the urinary system, stones in the biliary system, surgery on tonsils or adenoids, uterine polyps, any type of breast lumps, treatment for spondylosis or spondylitis, and inter-vertebral disc prolapse (IVDP).

question: How many times is the sum insured automatically restored under Star Health Assure and what is the restoration limit?
ground_truth: Under Star Health Assure, the sum insured is restored an unlimited number of times, up to 100% each time. Restoration triggers immediately upon partial or full utilisation and can be used for a subsequent hospitalisation.

question: Is treatment for refractive errors of the eye covered under Group Health Insurance?
ground_truth: Treatment for refractive errors of the eye is excluded under Group Health Insurance unless it results from an Accident or the correction required exceeds plus or minus 7.5 diopters.

question: What is the maximum age limit for adults under Star Health Assure and what is the minimum entry age for children?
ground_truth: The maximum age for adults under Star Health Assure is 75 years with a minimum of 18 years. Dependent children can be covered from a minimum of 16 days up to 25 years of age.

question: Which policy covers non-medical consumable items during hospitalisation?
ground_truth: Star Health Assure covers non-medical consumable items subject to an admissible claim under the policy. Details are available on the Star Health website.
